title: US-Iran War Has Made Every Middle East Country a Target, Says Jane Harman
summary: Jane Harman, former California Democratic congresswoman, said the US war in Iran has made every country in the Middle East a target, even countries that have not yet been participants in the conflict. Harman said that the danger of the conflict spreading is  'huge' and the US defense industrial base may not be prepared to address conflicts worldwide.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Oil Billionaire Hamm Seeks to Expand in Argentina’s Shale Patch
summary: US shale pioneer Harold Hamm is moving to expand his footprint in Argentina’s Vaca Muerta oil basin, home to the world’s fastest-growing shale boom, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: US-Iran War Flares as Fighting Spreads Across Mideast
summary: Fighting between the US and Iran has resumed after a brief lull, with American strikes focused on military targets and Tehran-aligned forces targeting US partners in the region. Israel has so far remained outside the latest exchange of strikes following Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s in-person talks with President Donald Trump. Bloomberg’s Dan Williams reports from Washington, DC. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Wall Street Delivers Harsh Verdict on Warsh Fed
summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh has vowed to reestablish the central bank's reputation as an inflation fighter. But on Wednesday he had to defend why the bank has held rates steady yet again. Some investors say it's time for Warsh to be a little more clear on the Fed's direction. Jonnelle Marte explains why  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: UK’s FCA to Publish Daily Stock-Trading Data Starting Friday

title: Mortgage Rates In US Rise to 6.66%, Highest Level In A Year
